title: test_a_census_names_every_outside_reader declares PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 300, so its 137 s wall is not read as a 120 s timeout
intention: The outside-readers census proof declares its own time limit above its measured wall, so a reseal that touches artifact.py runs it to a verdict instead of timing it out and staling the artifact component.
why: Measured 2026-11-20: cc_0 on akiendelllinux timed the census proof at 137 s wall; commit a71b39b54 records 133 s, 'past the reseal's default budget'. It declares no PROOF_TIMEOUT_S (cairn.devices.tester.device.declared_timeout returns None for it), so the reseal door's 120 s default budget applies, and every reseal touching cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py times it out.
traces_to: Law 9 (green is earned) and Law 3 (the budget follows the measured wall)
how: Add a top-level `PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 300` to cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_a_census_names_every_outside_reader.py. Budget = measured wall plus margin: 300 s is 2.2x the 137 s Linux wall and 2.5x the 120 s default that times it out. No Windows wall is read; if one measures above 300 s the number is re-measured, not guessed up. The mechanism is 8383a32d20c5's; the proof copies cf32e6f141e0's test_the_scratch_proof_declares_a_budget_above_its_wall, whose first tooth reds an undeclared proof because declared_timeout returns None.

clauses.claim: the census proof source declares PROOF_TIMEOUT_S as a top-level positive integer, 300, read through the tester's declared_timeout (None today, so this tooth is red before the build)
run_proof on a fixture carrying the census proof's declared value, at the reseal door's 120 s caller budget, records a run budget of 300, not 120

decisions.text: D1: cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_a_census_names_every_outside_reader.py declares a top-level PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 300; its teeth are unchanged.

D2: the red-first proof copies cf32e6f141e0's, retargeted at the census proof: tooth 1 reads declared_timeout == 300, tooth 2 runs run_proof on a scratch fixture carrying that value at a 120 s caller budget.

measured.saw: the census proof ran 137 s wall on Linux
measured.how: cc_0's timed run on akiendelllinux, relayed by the orchestrator

measured.saw: a71b39b54 records the census reseal at 133 s, past the reseal's default budget
declared_timeout returns None for the census proof
